summary: nora-social-bridge unit now also sets PATH to include node's directory (~/.local/bin, ~/.hermes/node/bin): opencli is a node script (shebang `#!/usr/bin/env node`), and the systemd USER environment carries no interactive PATH — once OPENCLI_BIN pointed at the real binary, the spawn failed next with `env: 'node': No such file or directory` (exit 127). With both env vars set, `/read` returns live post content.
